title: Open Gym Member Behavior Inputs
subtitle: Lisbon sport services memberships (CC BY 4.0) and weekly gym visits (CC0)
description:
Two filtered input files for the OGDT Member Behavior notebook.

lisboa_members.csv: 14,942 rows, 10 columns selected from the Sport Services Dataset by Paulo Pinheiro and Luis Cavique, Mendeley Data v1, doi:10.17632/yprk4jdgnv.1, licensed CC BY 4.0. Changes: columns selected (no user ID, age or gender); values unchanged.

carrera_weekly_visits.csv: 1,292 rows, 14 columns selected from the replication data of Carrera, Royer, Stehr, Sydnor and Taubinsky, Who Chooses Commitment? Evidence and Welfare Implications, Review of Economic Studies, doi:10.1093/restud/rdab056; Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.5173081. The package licence file dedicates the data to CC0 1.0. Changes: columns selected (no demographics); counts unchanged.

Code: https://github.com/victorgomezadapty/ogdt-member-behavior

resources.description: Sport Services Dataset (Pinheiro & Cavique), selected columns, CC BY 4.0
Carrera et al. weekly gym visits, selected columns, CC0 1.0
